briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 achieves 94% on ARC-AGI-2 as US-China compute restrictions tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-stakes phase with frontier labs releasing near-continuous model updates. Geopolitical controls on advanced chips are reshaping global training capacity while safety concerns mount around autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 4.1T parameters; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI shipped Grok-3; DeepSeek unveiled R2. Orion-2 leads on long-horizon planning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $4B Texas supercluster; TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production for US hyperscalers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced AI chips slow China's frontier progress by more than 18 months by 2028?
